g.text: Q1 source pins 1/2/3 -> VBAT; drains 5/6/7/8 -> VSERVO.

g.desc: Q1 source pins 1/2/3 -> VBAT; drains 5/6/7/8 -> VSERVO.

g.text: Gate pulled to source by R3: servo power OFF at reset.

g.desc: Gate pulled to source by R3: servo power OFF at reset.

g.text: PWM is forced LOW before switching servo rail OFF.

g.desc: PWM is forced LOW before switching servo rail OFF.

g.text: Use keyed battery cable; no reverse-polarity protection.

g.desc: Use keyed battery cable; no reverse-polarity protection.

g.text: BUOM C3 / REV A / 2S HV SERVO CARRIER

g.desc: BUOM C3 / REV A / 2S HV SERVO CARRIER

g.text: Do not fit a 1S-only servo or SG90/MG90S.
